Most recently I led product for Bluebird, Larkspur's internal reporting tool. Analysts used to wait on the data team to build every recurring report. Bluebird launched company-wide in May to 1,000+ analysts across finance, ops and marketing. For the first teams on it, report build time dropped from two days to 20 minutes. By September, 58% of recurring reports were built without a data-team ticket, and weekly active analysts were up 45% since April.

I also owned the build-versus-buy decision. We piloted two BI vendors, and neither could handle our metric definitions, so we kept building.
